visualCharacteristics.purpose: horizontal slider of program cards with prev/next arrows and area filter chips built from each card's area
visualCharacteristics.summary: Horizontal scroll slider with arrows and area filter chips built from card tags; eyebrow + meta row

contentPattern.structure: one row per program. Cell 1: image. Cell 2: eyebrow paragraph (e.g. "Máster Universitario en"), title (H3) linked to the program page, description paragraph, bulleted meta list (duration, ECTS, start date). Cell 3: area name, plain text (several areas separated by commas). Chips ("Todos" + each distinct area in first-seen order) appear when at least two areas exist; selecting a chip shows only that area's cards
contentPattern.summary: Descubre los principales títulos: Dynamic list of program cards each linking to a program detail page; chips filter by area and arrows scroll the row. Each card carries its area tag so the block builds the chips.

usage: Descubre los principales títulos, light-grey section style.
reuseGuidance: Use for long, filterable program lists. For a short static grid use cards-news.
